lines.zh: 我把一节节身子推向前。
lines.en: I push my segments forward one by one.
I crawl slowly, body flat to the ground.
I shift along the stone crack.
I crawl toward the smell of iron.

lines.zh: 我的身子扭了一下，转个弯。
lines.en: My body twists once to turn.

lines.zh: 我爬过一小片沙，留下一道线。
lines.en: I cross a patch of sand, leaving a line.
I slowly approach that originium.
I stop and lift my head to sniff.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块石头，继续走。
lines.en: I go around a stone and continue.

lines.zh: 我拖着身子，比看起来轻。
lines.en: I drag myself along, lighter than I look.
I inch three inches and stop again.
I drift slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 我爬上一块暖石，歇一会。
lines.en: I crawl onto a warm stone and rest.

lines.zh: 我的身子在沙上留下波纹。
lines.en: Ripples follow my body in the sand.
I hunt for food as I crawl.

lines.zh: 我从叶下钻过去，叶动了。
lines.en: I slip under a leaf, and it stirs.
I coil there, unmoving.

lines.zh: 我把头搁在石头上打盹。
lines.en: I rest my head on a stone and doze.
I'm sniffing, very carefully.
Tiny crystals speckle my body.

lines.zh: 我把身子圈成一个小环。
lines.en: I curl my body into a small ring.
I'm waiting for the smell of iron.
The sun is warm; I'm comfortable.
I twist once, slowly.

lines.zh: 我记得喂过我的那只手。
lines.en: I remember the hand that fed me.
I've little strength, and I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我靠近一块石头，贴上去。
lines.en: I near a stone and press against it.

lines.zh: 我吐了一点丝，缠在草上。
lines.en: I spin a little silk around the grass.
Your hands smell of iron.
I lift my head; you're tall.
Don't step on me.
Is that iron you're holding?
I crawl a little toward your feet.

lines.zh: 你的鞋边有铁屑，我看见了。
lines.en: There are iron filings by your boot. I see them.

lines.zh: 我的头很小，你看得见吗？
lines.en: My head is small; can you see it?
I remember your boots.
If you crouch, I'll relax.
I'm in your shadow; it's cool.
I curl into a ball and stay still.
One of my segments is flattened.
I shrink back under the stone.

lines.zh: 我吐了一点丝，缠住自己。
lines.en: I spin a little silk around myself.
That blow slowed me.
I don't cry out; I have no voice.
The pain pulls my body stiff and straight.
I've lost some crystal flecks.
I shudder and slowly stretch out.
I can still crawl, more slowly.
Iron! I smell iron.
That in your hand is iron, isn't it?
Let me try a bite.

lines.zh: 你把铁放下，我自己过去拿。
lines.en: Set the iron down; I'll come and take it myself.
That smell won't let me stop.
Give me iron, and I'll follow you.
I stretch my head and can't reach.
Lower it; I eat slowly.
Keep still; I won't bite your hand.
I smell the rust of iron.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴，我缩了。
lines.en: You step on my tail; I recoil.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的靴子上，滑了一下。
lines.en: I bump your boot and slide.
We meet, and I'm soft.

lines.zh: 我贴着你鞋底钻了过去。
lines.en: I slip right under the sole of your boot.
One touch and I coil.

lines.zh: 我被推得翻了一下，慢慢正过来。
lines.en: A push flips me; I right myself slowly.
I cling to your shoe and stay still.
You step back, and only then do I uncoil.
I hit a stone and my head spins.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，我就走了。
lines.en: We touch once, and I move on.
Another pokes its head from a crack.
Her body is a little shorter.

lines.zh: 我们并排盘着，谁都不动。
lines.en: We coil side by side, neither of us stirring.
She nuzzles my head.
We share a piece of iron.
We burrow under the stone together.
Her crystals are denser.
We need no sound.
She crawls ahead, and I follow.
Two bodies, one line.
I take up a fleck of iron.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的钉子叼走了。
lines.en: I carry off the nail you dropped.
I pick up a small piece of originium.

lines.zh: 我用头推了一下那块石头。
lines.en: I nudge that stone with my head.

lines.zh: 我把一片叶子拖到身下。
lines.en: I drag a leaf under me.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的手套，拖着走。
lines.en: I bite your glove and drag it.
I pick up a coin and swallow it.

lines.zh: 我把地上的箭头含在嘴里。
lines.en: I hold the arrowhead in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我拖不动那块铁，放弃了。
lines.en: I can't move that iron; I give up.
I push the bone shard aside.
That iron is mine.
I smell rust, just ahead.
I raise my head and take aim.
That small sound draws me.
I crawl that way without looking back.
I've chosen this hand.
My body tightens once.
The target isn't big; just right.

lines.zh: 我在石头下面等它靠近。
lines.en: I wait under the stone for it to come.

lines.zh: 我停在石头背面，等它路过。
lines.en: I stop behind the stone and wait for it to pass.
I stretch my head that way.
I've started crawling, slowly.
I follow along, flat to the soil.
I thread through the cracks.
It moves; I pause.
My head rises and lowers.
I'm a hand's width away.
I work around to its flank.

lines.zh: 我的身子在沙里划出线。
lines.en: My body draws a line in the sand.

lines.zh: 我伏在石缝里，等它再近些。
lines.en: I lie low in the crevice and wait for it to come nearer.
I wait for the moment it lowers its head.
I stop behind a stone.
I draw my head back and wait.
It backs off; I don't follow.
I bite down on the ankle.
I coil my whole body around it.

lines.zh: 我昂起头，朝它的膝盖顶。
lines.en: I rear up and butt its knee.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在它的手指上。
lines.en: This bite lands on its finger.
I drag it toward the crack.
The crystals on me dig into it.
It shakes twice and can't throw me off.
I bite and shrink back under the stone.
I sink my teeth hard into its toes.

lines.zh: 它踩了我一下，我才松口。
lines.en: It steps on me; only then do I let go.

lines.zh: 石缝里钻出一个小脑袋。
lines.en: A small head pushes out of a crack.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来，很小一条。
lines.en: I hatch from an egg, a tiny thing.
The stones here are warm.

lines.zh: 我刚离开卵，就闻到铁锈。
lines.en: Barely out of the egg, I smell rust.

lines.zh: 土里有铁锈味，我从缝里钻。
lines.en: Rust in the soil; I squeeze out through the crack.
I crawl a little way over the sand.
My body hasn't grown out yet.
Someone's moving nearby.

lines.zh: 我把自己盘起来，先看看。
lines.en: I coil up and take a look first.

lines.zh: 石缝裂开，我从里面滑出来。
lines.en: The crack opens and I slide out.
At the heat, I burrow into the soil.
I fall and land on stone.

lines.zh: 水浸进我的节缝，动不了。
lines.en: Water seeps into my segments; I can't move.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹出去，我滚了几圈。
lines.en: The blast throws me into a roll.
An arrow buries itself in the soil beside me.
A light covers me, and I stiffen.
Without iron, I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打在石头上，我跳了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits the stone, and I jerk.

lines.zh: 这里没有石缝，我一直在掉。
lines.en: There are no cracks here; I keep falling.
